sentences.literal: It governs eight counties; households are thirty-four thousand.
sentences.idiomatic: The commandery administered eight counties and recorded thirty-four thousand households.
Xingyang County

sentences.literal: The place takes its name from Ao; the Qin were the ones who established the Ao Granary there.
sentences.idiomatic: The site was called Ao; the Qin built the famous Ao Granary on this ground.
Jing County

sentences.literal: The place where Duan, the Grand Uncle of Zheng, dwelt.
sentences.idiomatic: Here lived royal uncle Duan of Zheng, celebrated in the Zuo tradition.
Mi County

sentences.literal: Formerly within the inner royal domain of Zhou.
sentences.idiomatic: The county lay in what had been the near domain of the Western Zhou kings.
Juan County

sentences.chinese: 〈有博浪長沙，張良擊秦始皇處。
sentences.literal: There is Bolangsha, the place where Zhang Liang struck the First Emperor of Qin.
sentences.idiomatic: Bolangsha lies here—the spot where Zhang Liang staged his hammer attack on the First Emperor of Qin.
The commentary note closes here.

sentences.chinese: 陽武 苑陵 中牟
sentences.idiomatic: The same commandery also included Yangwu, Yuanling, and Zhongmou counties.

sentences.literal: In the age of the Six States, Marquis Xian of Zhao made it his capital.
sentences.idiomatic: During the Warring States era it had served as the capital of Marquis Xian of Zhao.
Kaifeng County

sentences.literal: Pengchi of Song is northeast; some call it Peng Marsh.
sentences.idiomatic: To the northeast lay Song's Pengchi, also known as the Peng marshland.
Hongnong Commandery
The Han dynasty first founded the commandery.

sentences.literal: It governs six counties; households are fourteen thousand.
sentences.idiomatic: It ruled six counties and counted fourteen thousand households.
Hongnong County
The county seat began as the site of Hangu Pass.

sentences.literal: Emperor Wu of the Han shifted it to Xinan County.
sentences.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han relocated the administrative seat into Xinan County.
Hu County

sentences.literal: Therefore it was called Hu written 胡; Emperor Wu of the Han changed the name to Hu written 湖.
sentences.idiomatic: Its old name used the character meaning “barbarian,” homophonous with the later graph for “lake,” which Emperor Wu of Han adopted for the county name.
Shan County

sentences.chinese: 〈故虢國，周分陝東西，二相主之。〉
sentences.literal: Formerly the state of Guo; Zhou divided east and west of Shan, and two ministers governed them.
sentences.idiomatic: This had been Guo; when the Zhou kings split stewardship east and west of Shan, two senior ministers ruled the respective halves.

sentences.chinese: 宜陽 黽池 華陰
sentences.idiomatic: Additional counties were Yiyang, Mianchi, and Huayin.

sentences.literal: Mount Hua lies south of the county.
sentences.idiomatic: Precipitous Mount Hua rose just south of the county seat.
Shangluo Commandery

sentences.literal: In the second year of Taishi, it was established by partitioning the southern part of Jingzhao.
sentences.idiomatic: Founded in 266 from the southern zone of Jingzhao under Emperor Wu of Jin.

sentences.literal: It governs three counties; households are seventeen thousand.
sentences.idiomatic: Its register ran to three counties and seventeen thousand households.
Shangluo County

sentences.literal: Yaoguan lies northwest of the county.
sentences.idiomatic: The Yaoguan barrier stood northwest of the county seat.
Shang County

sentences.literal: The town allotment of Wei Yang, chief minister of Qin.
sentences.idiomatic: The chief minister Shang Yang of Qin had held this as his personal fief.
Lushi County

sentences.literal: Mount Xiong'er is to the east; it is where the Yi River rises.
sentences.idiomatic: Mount Xiong'er dominated the eastern skyline, and the Yi River sprang from its slopes.
Pingyang Commandery

sentences.literal: Formerly belonged to Hedong; Wei split it off and established it separately.
sentences.idiomatic: Carved out of Hedong when Wei formed its own regional administration.

sentences.literal: It governs twelve counties; households are forty-two thousand.
sentences.idiomatic: Twelve counties and forty-two thousand households fell under its jurisdiction.
Pingyang County
It was remembered as an ancient capital of Emperor Yao.
The county seat was bundled into a marquisate.
Yang County
The ground once formed the fief of the Marquis of Yang.
Duanshi County

sentences.chinese: 〈韓、魏、趙既爲諸侯，以端氏封晉君也。〉
sentences.literal: When Han, Wei, and Zhao had already become feudal lords, they used Duanshi to enfeoff the lord of Jin.
sentences.idiomatic: After Han, Wei, and Zhao gained rank as independent lords, they parked the last ruler of Jin at Duanshi as his residual domain.
Yong'an County

sentences.literal: Formerly the state of the Earl of Huo.
sentences.idiomatic: It corresponded to the old Huo earldom.

sentences.literal: Mount Huo lies to the east.
sentences.idiomatic: Mount Huo rose directly east of the county.

sentences.chinese: 蒲子 狐讘 襄陵
sentences.idiomatic: The commandery further comprised Puzi, Huniè, and Xiangling counties.
The county magistrate doubled as chancellor to a dukedom.
Jiangyi County

sentences.literal: Duke Wu of Jin moved here from Quwo.
sentences.idiomatic: Duke Wu of Jin transferred his seat hither from Quwo.
Huozé County
Mount Xicheng bounded the county on the southwest.
Linfen County
The magistrate also served as chancellor to a dukedom.
Beiqu County
The Hukou Narrows of the Yellow River lay toward the southeast boundary.

sentences.literal: There is Nanqu, therefore it is called North Qu.
sentences.idiomatic: Because another Qu county lay to the south, this one took the epithet “North.”
Pishi County
The territory was once the small polity of Geng.
Hedong Commandery
The Qin empire first drew the circuit.

sentences.chinese: 統縣九，戶四萬二千五百。〉
sentences.literal: It governs nine counties; households are forty-two thousand five hundred.
sentences.idiomatic: Nine counties and forty-two thousand five hundred households answered to it.
Anyi County
Tradition credited the town as an ancient seat of Emperor Shun.
Wenxi County
It was the old Quwo heartland.

sentences.literal: Duke Wu of Jin moved here from Jinyang.
sentences.idiomatic: Duke Wu of Jin relocated his court hither from Jinyang.
Yuan County

sentences.literal: Mount Wangwu is northeast; it is where the Yuan River rises.
sentences.idiomatic: Mount Wangwu towered northeast, and the Yuan River issued from its foothills.
Fenyang County
The magistrate held the added title of chancellor to a dukedom.
The gloss concludes here.
Dayang County

sentences.literal: Mount Wu lies to the west.
sentences.idiomatic: Mount Wu (or the Wu range) stood on the western frontier.

sentences.chinese: 周武王封西周太伯後於此。〉
sentences.literal: King Wu of Zhou enfeoffed the descendants of Taibo of Western Zhou here.
sentences.idiomatic: King Wu of Zhou granted this ground to the junior line descended from Taibo, who had yielded the Zhou succession.
Yishi County
The place preserved the memory of Yidun, the legendary salt-and-jade magnate.
Xie County
Vast solar-evaporation salt pools lay inside its borders.
Puban County

sentences.literal: There is Mount Li, where Shun plowed.
sentences.idiomatic: Mount Li, where legendarily Shun farmed, rose nearby.

sentences.chinese: 有雷首山，夷齊居其陽，所謂首陽山。〉
sentences.literal: There is Mount Leishou; Boyi and Shuqi dwelt on its yang slope—what is called Mount Shouyang.
sentences.idiomatic: Mount Leishou also appeared; on its sunny shoulder Boyi and Shuqi withdrew—the range later honored as Mount Shouyang.
Hebei County
Ji Commandery

sentences.literal: Established in the second year of Taishi.
sentences.idiomatic: Created in 266, the second year of the Taishi era.

sentences.literal: It governs six counties; households are thirty-seven thousand.
sentences.idiomatic: Six counties and thirty-seven thousand households were enrolled.
Ji County
The strategic Bronze Pass lay within its perimeter.
Zhaoge County
It had been the royal seat of Di Xin, the last king of Shang.
Gong County
The ground had once been the petty kingdom of Gong.

sentences.literal: Beishan is where the Qi River rises.
sentences.idiomatic: Beishan marked the headwaters of the Qi River.
Rounding out the commandery were Linlü and Huojia counties.
It began as Xinzhong township inside old Ji county.

sentences.chinese: 漢武帝行過時，獲呂嘉首，因改名。〉
sentences.literal: When Emperor Wu of the Han passed through on campaign, he obtained the head of Lü Jia, and on that account changed the name.
sentences.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Han renamed it after his army seized and beheaded the Nanyue minister Lü Jia while the court traveled the circuit.
Xiuwu County

sentences.literal: The Nanyang that Jin opened; the Qin changed the name to Xiuwu.
sentences.idiomatic: This tract had been the Nanyang territory that the dukes of Jin first opened; the conquering Qin bureaucracy rededicated it as Xiuwu.
